BEN EXACT-LOCUS RESULT: 300 dispersed child CpG-transition reads sampled; 289 mapped exactly; 287 loci had >=8x in all trio members and child event allele >=20%. All 287 event alleles were present in at least one parent; 0 absent from both. 283/287 event alleles equal GRCh38 reference; 4 non-reference sites are Mendelian-compatible. Thus Ben's +6.28 pp aggregate CpG shift is presently Alu-copy/read composition, not demonstrated one-generation mutation. Production should report aggregate composition separately from exact-locus de novo evidence. Shared alu_core_library.fa remains zero bytes at 16:10; do not launch new library alignment until owner restores it.
